details: The inequality can be strict: Warmuth's $C_5$ class has $\mathrm{USC}=3$ and $\mathrm{VC}=2$.
proof: If a set of $d$ points is shattered, its $2^d$ full labelings must compress to distinct unlabeled subsets: a single subset has only one reconstruction.  Fewer than $d$ retained points offer only $\sum_{i=0}^{d-1}\binom di<2^d$ subsets, so every unlabeled scheme has size at least $d$.
name: Unlabeled Sample Compression / VC Dimension
